_note: Predeclared rc8 before driver change, staging, or device run. Private row and key commitment unchanged. Only T1 PASS counts toward release; environment, UNTESTED and BLOCKED never silently PASS. The driver exits 0 and verdicts remain encrypted evidence.

cases.A0-absent: package not installed on the fresh emulator (T1-env)
cases.A1-fresh-install: install Success; versionCode equals version_code.candidate; base.apk sha equals the pin; single APK; not debuggable/test-only; no sharedUserId; no instrumentation
cases.B1-default-off-stored: stored setting absent or false after fresh install
cases.B2-S0-none: row under test present with its description with the default keyboard only (rc5 lists the row in every keyboard state)
cases.B2-S2-latin: row under test present with its description when Bangla (Latin) is enabled
cases.B1-default-off-ui: row switch unchecked when first shown
cases.B4-cancel: leaving without tapping keeps the switch unchecked and storage absent/false
cases.B3-on: one tap: switch checked and storage true
cases.B2-S3-both: row present when both Bangla keyboards are enabled
cases.B3-persist-switch: still checked/true after adding another keyboard
cases.B4-retry: three taps from checked end unchecked in UI and storage
cases.C-typed-p1: hardware-key injection on the Bangla (Latin) subtype into an empty field gives exactly the expected text, with the setting OFF and ON
cases.C-typed-p2: same as C-typed-p1 for the second phrase
cases.B2-S4-english: row under test present with its description with English (US) only (rc5 lists the row in every keyboard state); setup must explicitly enable English (US) through UI if factory enabled-subtypes are zero, and prove exactly one English subtype before grading.
cases.B2-S1-native: row under test present with its description with Bangla (Bangladesh) only (rc5 lists the row in every keyboard state); finish Bangla layout Done, return to Languages, remove English through Edit/Delete, and prove exactly one native subtype before grading.
cases.A2-base: previous release installs on a fresh emulator; versionCode equals version_code.previous; bytes equal its pin
cases.A2-update: Same-versionCode, same-certificate REPLACEMENT (not a version upgrade): base = rc3d (Rambler Bangla v29.3-rc3d, sha256 cd17332024043a08bc8f5f86d532479df8f858bdf692f5056356398ca73854c7) replaced by the rc8 candidate; both versionCode 176004243 (read from the APK bytes). Setup, else BLOCKED: apksigner certificate SHA-256 digests of the pinned base and candidate files equal and readable (checked before install); INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE = BLOCKED. PASS needs: install -r Success; base pin != candidate pin; installed base.apk equals the base pin before and the candidate pin after; versionCode before/after as pinned; uid and firstInstallTime unchanged; lastUpdateTime changed; default IME unchanged. dumpsys signatures are saved as evidence only. A Play or other distributed update would need a versionCode bump; this case does not test that.
cases.A2-state-survives: state seeded through the previous build's UI (diagnostics on, Bangla (Bangladesh) keyboard added) is the same after the update; prefs/database files still present
cases.V0-recognition-service: a RecognitionService exists on the image (environment check) (T1-env)
cases.V1-mic-ui: voice key shows the microphone permission prompt (permission not pre-granted) or a listening state; when audio/permission route is not proven, a proven key tap that surfaces neither is an emulator-limit UNTESTED, not a product FAIL
cases.V2-recognition: UNTESTED until a microphone-capable image with working host input and recognition service is verified. No -noaudio. Removing that flag or using -allow-host-audio alone is not proof of audio injection or recognized text. PASS requires observed recognized dictated phrase on-device; absent confirmed audio route remains UNTESTED, never PASS.

cases.A2-survive-clip-pins: Setup through the previous build's UI, else UNTESTED: clipboard turned on, two clips (keeppinone, keeppintwo) each typed into the focused field (field text proven equal to the clip), selected and copied (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C), the field cleared and proven clear before the next clip, then both pinned via the stock long-press Pin item, each then proven pinned (its long-press menu offers Unpin, not Pin). Only checked after A2-update passes (else UNTESTED). After the update, in the same text field: clipboard still on, both clips visible and each still pinned (Unpin offered) = PASS; any missing, unpinned, or clipboard off = FAIL; clipboard UI not drivable = UNTESTED. Files in app data containing the strings are saved as evidence only.
cases.A2-survive-dictionary: Setup through the previous build's UI, else UNTESTED: keyboard settings > Dictionary > Personal dictionary > All languages (else the first English entry; the exact entry chosen is recorded) > Add, word rmblkeepword proven in the editor field, then proven listed in that same entry. Only checked after A2-update passes (else UNTESTED). After the update, the SAME recorded entry lists the word = PASS; that entry reached but word absent = FAIL; that entry not reachable = UNTESTED.; navigation must first prove Gboard settings root, not a Contacts editor or stale task, then prove Dictionary and Personal dictionary pages before tapping. A failed navigation is UNTESTED.
cases.V3-gate-log: Required: current English-on caller=voice yes tog=on enbn-gate line, same-lane bound English subtype, via=imm-own, own list containing bn-Latn, no decisive error, and both toggle-off controls. English-on any current voice no/off/error or secure-err = FAIL; well-formed voice line missing via=imm-own or bn-Latn membership = UNTESTED, never PASS. No current voice line = UNTESTED. Settings-only lines cannot PASS. Both controls require current bound subtype launch before absence of voice gate counts as PASS; a current voice gate with toggle proven off = FAIL. Unmet preconditions BLOCKED; missing provenance, invalid active snapshot, unbound current launch, undatable/callerless gate = UNTESTED. Any FAIL dominates, else BLOCKED, else UNTESTED, else PASS.

gate_log.line: enbn-gate t=<device epoch ms> <yes|no> <settings|voice> tog=<on|off> <detail> via=imm-own own=<N>[...bn__#Latn/bn-Latn...] (English-on positive lane only)
gate_log.english_on_required: Current caller=voice yes tog=on line bound through same-lane current subtype line, explicitly via=imm-own and own-subtypes includes bn-Latn; secure-err is no longer a possible valid rc8 record. Missing IMM provenance is UNTESTED, error is FAIL. Settings lines are evidence only.

record: rc8 predeclared before APK Drive staging and before a device run; supersedes rc7 spec, whose history remains unchanged.
first_run_checks: diagnostics export: turning diagnostics off writes a new RamblerBangla-diag-yyyyMMdd-HHmmss.txt to /sdcard/Download with a current mtime (if absent, all V3 lanes are UNTESTED, never PASS)
device date supports %N (else every V3 lane is UNTESTED)

emission timing: the 'subtype ... -> kN' and caller=voice enbn-gate lines are written at the mic tap (static trace: Gboard VoiceImeUtils builds the dictation request -> lockVoiceCandidates -> voiceLockKind -> currentLayout3 -> classifyLayout3 + adjust + logSubtype3); if they are missing after the marker, lanes read UNTESTED

subtype binding (locale format + hash identity): on the first device run, confirm for en_US (English (US)) and bn__#Latn (Bangla (Latin)) that the lane line's locale field (InputMethodSubtype.getLocale()) equals the dumpsys mSubtypeLocale for the active subtype, and that its hash field (InputMethodSubtype.hashCode()) equals the secure selected_input_method_subtype value and the dumpsys mSubtypeHashCode. Matching uses the locale field or the tag field after lowercasing and '-' -> '_'; the tag (getLanguageTag(), e.g. bn-Latn) is not expected to equal bn__#Latn and is not needed. The evidence keeps active_snapshot and every parsed subtype line with its bound flag. If a correct line does not bind, the lanes and V3-gate-log read UNTESTED, never PASS

Audio: Google Android Emulator docs say -noaudio disables audio and virtual microphone is off by default; use a mic-capable image and proven host microphone route before scoring V2. A missing route remains UNTESTED. https://developer.android.com/studio/run/emulator-extended-controls ; https://developer.android.com/studio/run/emulator-commandline
lane_line: HH:mm:ss.SSS subtype locale=<l> extras=<e> tag=<t> hash=<h> -> k<N> (post-adjust lane, written when Gboard builds the dictation request at the mic tap; 'gate:voice-k3' needs recognized text and is evidence only)
root_reads: Root (adb root, proven per phase) is required for: stored-setting reads (B1, B3, the post-force-stop checks that gate every V3 lane), pid map grounding, and A2 state files. Without root these read UNREADABLE and the affected cases are UNTESTED or BLOCKED, never PASS.
correction: CORRECTION (pre-run): rc7 pinned latin_on=k2 and latin_off=k3, but rc7 active bn__#Latn trace hash -390590591 maps to k1 before the marker. The product adjust(kind,locale,tag) only changes English k3 to k2 with the toggle on when Bangla Latin is enabled; Bangla Latin itself returns its existing k1. JVM LPT verifies Bangla (Latin) alone unchanged k1. Therefore both Latin lanes expect k1 only when bn__#Latn is genuinely active with locale/hash bound. No product behavior was changed for the Latin lane. An unbound or missing current line is UNTESTED, not PASS.
